test.create_query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parquet_array_repdef_{len} (arr Array(UInt8)) ENGINE = File(Parquet) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_compression_method = 'none', output_format_parquet_max_dictionary_size = 0, output_format_parquet_data_page_size = 1048576, output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 1000000000, output_format_parquet_parallel_encoding = 0, output_format_parquet_write_checksums = 0, output_format_parquet_write_page_index = 0, output_format_parquet_write_bloom_filter = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO parquet_array_repdef_{len} SELECT arrayWithConstant({len}, toUInt8(number % 251)) FROM numbers(intDiv(16777216, {len})) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 65536
